notes.title: Update 1.2 available.
notes.notes:
We just released update 1.2 .

For those who want more challenges we added  next room with 15 levels and new rules.

Now you can play with your kids – we added child mode which adjusts the height of the room to growth of player.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25578070/c7aa325359e522d0470ea58dd25c6c9cb5bec374.png

So now you have 90 colorfull challenging levels.

Have fun.

notes.title: Update 1.1 available.
notes.notes:
We are happy to present you the 1.1 update to all users so you had more fun playing DUO.
We made some additions and some improvements.

ADDITIONS:
- New room with new rules
If you already passed through all levels we've got for you next room with 15 new colorfull levels.
To make it more difficult we added one more ball.
Now you have to keep an eye on 3 balls in the same time.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25578070/c6db1ca2de54faae01d32590568a6b7f84a06158.png

- Hard mode
For those who need more challenges we added hard mode for all levels.


IMPROVEMENTS:
- We fixed problem with saving scores.
- We enlarged the space in the circle.
- Better balls and paddles physics.

We hope you will enjoy the updates and please keep the information and ideas coming.
New challenges await so keep a lot of fun with the game!  ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Update is coming soon
notes.notes:
Hello Everyones:)

First of all great thanks for the interest in Duo so far!

We are glad to hear your positive opinion about our game, but we are not finished yet.
All the time we are improving DUO so you  have more fun with the game.

In a very near future we are planning some updates.

That means new interesting features and more challenging levels for you.
- New room with 15 next levels is waiting.

Hopefully you've trained your skills already because now it might be more difficult.
- Hard mode has been added.

We would like to hear your opinion about the game so far. 
By the way if you liked the game, leaving a review will help us.

We hope you will enjoy the update and please keep the information and ideas coming.

New challenges await so keep a lot of fun with the game!
